about_the_game:
Story

You and Yuki have known each other since childhood. She has always been incredibly attentive to you, always there when you needed her, but you never really paid much attention to it…

You’ve come back from college for the summer break, and Yuki casually invites you to spend the night at her house. Her parents are away, so it’s just the two of you.

You can try to reconnect with her — talk, relax, maybe share some memories — or you can choose to do nothing, stay in the shadows, and hope to survive the night safely. But every decision has consequences. The main thing — don’t make her angry.

Yuki isn’t the kind of girl you can ignore. If you make the wrong move, try to leave, or act against her will, she’ll get angry. And when she’s angry, she won’t stop until she finds you. Her patience is short, and her obsession is dangerous.

If you obey her and carefully follow her instructions, you might have a chance to survive the night.

You’ll have to watch her mood, predict her desires, and avoid provoking jealousy or rage.

The game is built around 3 modes

  • Life — you can freely move around the house and talk to Yuki, but she will keep an eye on you, won’t let you enter locked rooms, and will get upset if you try to escape.

  • Quiet Hour — you must stay in the room, but if Yuki isn’t watching, you can sneak out and explore the house. If Yuki sees you, you must return to the room as quickly as possible, or she’ll become upset.

  • Hunt — if Yuki gets upset because of you, she’ll start hunting and try to kill you. You can freely explore the house, but be careful — or Yuki’s knife will end up in your chest.

Gameplay Features

  • Communication with Yuki happens through a microphone. The dialogues are pre-written.

  • Explore rooms, find clues, and decide how to behave around her. Every choice affects her mood — and your chances of survival.

  • Explore Yuki’s house — search for items, keys, and secrets hidden in different rooms.

  • Interact with Yuki — talk to her, answer her questions, or stay silent to avoid suspicion.

  • Escape system — collect items, unlock doors, and plan your way to freedom.

Minimum:

short_description: Spend the night in a house with a yandere girl. Explore the rooms, find objects and clues, and monitor her mood. Every action can save you—or anger her. Fulfill her wishes or try to escape before it's too late.

English*, Simplified Chinese*, Russian*, Japanese*
